label: Q01
loop: one player picks an object on a seek-and-find sheet -> the other finds it while the first marks X's on their board -> switch turns -> first to fill the board wins -> earn cash for skins and chairs
objectives: fill your board before your opponent by finding objects quickly
progression: cash for cosmetic chairs and skins, win streaks
instructions: pick an object, find the object, mark your page, fill it first to win
unique: seek-and-find picture book turned into a 1v1 bingo-style race
paid sabotage (blind opponent, clear opponent's board)
thumbnails: two avatars at a table with a seek-and-find sheet; 'Can you find the apple?' puzzle shot
complexity_notes: table scene, 2D seek-and-find sheets, turn logic and matchmaking

label: Q02
loop: hiders lie still faking death among ragdolls -> seeker searches and shoots -> hiders who survive revenge with a knife -> new round on a new map
objectives: as hider survive by playing dead; as seeker find and shoot all hiders
instructions: hider: fake death and survive, use knife for revenge; seeker: find them all and shoot
unique: playing dead as the hiding mechanic
thumbnails: a 'dead' X-eyed avatar lying on grass, autumn leaves and a disco floor
complexity_notes: round-based hide and seek with several small maps, simple weapons

label: Q03
loop: start on a blank voxel world -> place blocks and furniture -> build with friends or troll with TNT and weapons -> builds save in private servers
instructions: build big, build weird, play solo or with friends
unique: heavy pay-for-chaos tools in a creative sandbox
thumbnails: an avatar next to elaborate voxel builds: windmill, mushroom house, palace, pagoda
complexity_notes: voxel building system with saving, many block types and tools

label: Q04
loop: plant durian trees -> grow giant durians with mutations -> harvest and load your truck -> sell for cash -> expand farm, survive the purge and steal durians -> rebirth
progression: 6 durian varieties, mutations, farm expansion, rebirths
instructions: plant, grow, harvest, load truck, sell; survive the purge and protect your farm
unique: durian theme with a purge-night stealing event
thumbnails: a giant durian beside an avatar carrying a box
complexity_notes: farm plots, growth timers, truck selling; templated grow-a-garden systems

label: Q05
loop: break into an abandoned underground park -> sneak, hide in lockers, grapple and flash your camera to escape a voice-reactive animatronic -> uncover the story or survive chase mode
objectives: escape the monster and uncover the truth
progression: story chapters, cash for permanent gear, lives
instructions: stay quiet, hide, grapple to escape, flash the camera to blind him; story or chase mode
unique: monster hears your mic and talks back
thumbnails: a grinning animatronic bear in dark corridors
complexity_notes: custom monster AI that climbs and crawls vents, voice detection, story mode, atmospheric lighting

label: Q06
loop: smash a giant wall -> earn gems -> upgrade or rent stronger tools -> break into the next room -> repeat
objectives: break out of room after room
instructions: smash the walls, upgrade tools, escape rooms solo or with up to 4
thumbnails: first-person fists and a drill breaking a wall with an 'E BREAK' prompt

label: Q07
loop: ride a motorcycle through endless highway traffic -> do wheelies and tricks for cash and XP -> buy bikes and customize them -> daily quests
objectives: weave through traffic at high speed and build a bike collection
progression: cash, XP, bikes from the dealership, customization
instructions: swerve through traffic, pop wheelies, buy and customize bikes; code RELEASE
unique: endless highway traffic-weaving with death wobbles
thumbnails: glossy sport bikes and a first-person night highway shot
complexity_notes: bike physics, large streaming highway map with traffic AI, detailed customization

label: Q08
loop: team up on a raft -> fart to steer and boost down a river -> dodge obstacles without overheating -> reach the finish -> earn coins and keys for crates of farts, rafts and skins
objectives: reach the finish of each river world
progression: new worlds, crates, fart and raft skins
instructions: fart to steer, don't overheat, dodge hammers and rotors, reach the finish
thumbnails: pink hippos on a raft blasting green farts down a colourful river
complexity_notes: raft physics, several themed worlds with moving obstacles

label: Q09
loop: hide inside an egg to sneak into other players' plots -> carry eggs back (train strength for heavier eggs) -> hatch pets -> pets earn money -> rarer eggs
objectives: steal and hatch the rarest eggs
instructions: hide in eggs, train strength, steal eggs, hatch pets, earn money
unique: disguise as an egg to sneak into bases
thumbnails: an avatar's head disguised as an egg among chicken eggs, 'YOU' arrows, 'Egg SECRET'
complexity_notes: plot base template with stealing and hatching; simple disguise

label: Q10
loop: choose between two doors -> each grants a winter outfit item or a ruinous one -> climb through 4 towers -> see final outfit at the top -> replay for a new outfit
objectives: build the best winter outfit by the top of the tower
instructions: choose a door, build your outfit, climb 4 winter towers
unique: would-you-rather doors that dress your avatar
thumbnails: two doors labelled with winter clothes and a question mark; a cozy-dressed character
complexity_notes: door choice towers with accessory randomization

label: Q11
loop: gain +1 speed per step -> run treadmills and multipliers -> race through laboratory keyboard courses -> escape further -> climb speed leaderboards
objectives: become the fastest player and escape the lab
instructions: gain +1 speed every step, unlock multipliers, escape the lab
thumbnails: green keyboard keys with +1 pops and a running avatar, 'OFFLINE SPEED'
complexity_notes: templated +1 speed sim with themed course

label: Q12
loop: rob houses at night with your crew -> sneak past residents, avoid police and dogs -> sell loot before the deadline -> pay off the debt or face the sniper -> buy better tools
objectives: pay off the debt by robbing the city
instructions: rob the city at night, sneak, outrun police, sell loot before the deadline
unique: quota-debt heist loop like Lethal Company
thumbnails: masked robbers sneaking past sleeping residents, crowbar through glass
complexity_notes: NPC residents, police and dog AI, loot carrying, houses to rob

label: Q13
loop: scan waterpark guests for hidden weapons -> save drowning guests -> earn cash -> upgrade lifeguard and security gear -> survive a longer, crazier shift
objectives: keep the waterpark safe and become the ultimate lifeguard
progression: cash, gear upgrades, classes, new areas
instructions: scan guests, find weapons, save drowners, earn cash and upgrade
unique: airport-security style scanning in a waterpark
thumbnails: x-ray scanner revealing a gun inside a guest, lifeguard pushing a guest down a slide
complexity_notes: NPC guest AI with randomized contraband, shift escalation

label: Q14
loop: row out with your crew to a ghost steamboat -> explore it while a horror Mickey-like creature hunts you -> try to escape
instructions: row out to the steamboat with your crew and try to leave
thumbnails: a grainy black-and-white cartoon mouse peeking from a door
complexity_notes: atmospheric ship map with monster AI

label: Q15
loop: free-roam with Rick and Morty portal guns and gadgets -> fight other players with portals and blasters -> loot backpacks
objectives: unclear; fight and mess around with portals
instructions: controls for portal gun, dimensions, mech blaster, robo arms
unique: working portals as a PvP sandbox tool
thumbnails: Rick-like avatar stepping out of a green portal on a baseplate
